NO.name: Norway
NO.note: ssb and fhi have first-class adapters (search_catalog + canonical ssb.read); norgesbank (SDMX) covers interest rates and FX.

DK.name: Denmark
DK.note: dst has a searchable adapter — use search_catalog with source='dst'.

SE.name: Sweden
SE.note: scb has a searchable PxWeb adapter — use search_catalog with source='scb'.

FI.name: Finland
FI.note: statfin has a searchable adapter — use search_catalog with source='statfin'.

IS.name: Iceland
IS.note: No Hagstofa adapter — use eurostat (covers IS) or web_fetch px.hagstofa.is.

DE.name: Germany
DE.note: No Destatis adapter — use eurostat or dbnomics (both cover DE), or web_fetch Genesis pages.

FR.name: France
FR.note: No INSEE adapter — use eurostat or dbnomics (INSEE series are indexed on dbnomics).

ES.name: Spain
ES.note: No INE adapter — use eurostat or dbnomics.

PT.name: Portugal
PT.note: No INE adapter — use eurostat or dbnomics.

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.note: No CBS adapter — use eurostat or dbnomics.

IT.name: Italy
IT.note: No Istat adapter — use eurostat or dbnomics.

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.note: No ONS adapter — use dbnomics, worldbank or oecd; web_fetch ons.gov.uk for UK-specific series.

US.name: United States
US.agency: the U.S. statistical agencies (Census Bureau, BLS, and FRED)
US.note: fred is in the registry (some series need a user key via AI settings); worldbank, oecd and dbnomics cover the US; IPUMS covers NHIS/MEPS microdata.

BR.name: Brazil
BR.note: No IBGE adapter — use worldbank or dbnomics (IBGE and central-bank series are indexed there), or web_fetch sidra.ibge.gov.br.

CN.name: China
CN.agency: the National Bureau of Statistics of China
CN.note: No NBS adapter — use worldbank, dbnomics or owid for China series.

JP.name: Japan
JP.note: No e-Stat adapter — use worldbank, oecd or dbnomics (all cover JP).

IN.name: India
IN.agency: the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
IN.note: No MoSPI adapter — use worldbank, dbnomics or owid for India series.
